causalHypothesis.X: High-cost full collective-closure evaluations certify late terminal Hall failures for an already selected exact future-chain geometry.
causalHypothesis.Y: searchJoint -> visitChain/visitAgenda -> PreparedFutureCollectiveParticipantClosure.evaluateContext builds all 19 terminal domains and ancestor/departure checks before discovering a two-participant Hall; the invariant joint endpoints are already entailed by that candidate root+phase permutation.
causalHypothesis.Z: Repeated canPlaceTask/diagnoseTaskPlacement/dependency-map work dominates S1; the demonstrated pair Hall costs 38.133 ms with full context versus 2.455 ms with the necessary optimistic pair check. The historical head timing increase itself is not causally proved.
causalHypothesis.W: Candidate-only NECESSARY Hall on affected terminal participants through the existing evaluateIndividualContinuation authority, retaining protected geometry and optimistically removing unaccepted IN/entry occupations; run it where the exact candidate endpoints are already entailed, before full terminal-domain work. PASS/ABSTAIN only continue existing exploration; rejection never propagates to Main/root/other permutation. No implementation is proposed until full replay proves net benefit and charged wiring.

M.toFalsify: Replay all distinct closure contexts/candidate choices with unchanged input, then demonstrate net whole-S1 saving greater than control variability (target at least 10%), exact 266/266 S10 material/protection/completeness, same final certificate and no new HARD/REQUIRED, ledger <=100000 with every new check charged; no budget/timeout changes.

causalHypothesis.nextMinimalDelta: Read-only replay/instrumentation of the same candidate-only predicate across ALL 4,070 distinct contexts, including successful and cached states, measuring added PASS work, avoided domain/validation work and exact proposed ledger charges. No productive filter/cache/explorer/refactor until that experiment passes.
